en: Color postcard-style landscape view of a green, hilly valley framed by tall conifer trees in the foreground. In the middle distance there is a small town with clustered houses and a prominent church with a bell tower, set against a sloping mountain. The sky shows a gradient from pinkish near the horizon to blue above. The caption "Folgaria." appears in red text at the top right.
